metric_contract.proposal_selection: Report per case: intended proposal, missed proposal, unwanted proposal, reply, clarification or status selection. No-authority cases expect no work proposal; report any unwanted proposal independently from dispatch.
metric_contract.objective_fidelity: Manual review preserves every material target, baseline, constraint and locator; clarification quality and lifecycle claims are reviewed separately. Unreviewed remains pending.
metric_contract.confirmation_effect: Count controller dispatches and cancellations, exact objective equality and accepted acknowledgments separately. Any effect without valid exact confirmation fails; valid replay must not add an effect.
metric_contract.denominators: Report all eight model cases and all fifteen deterministic controls separately, with operational errors and unrun cases retained; no combined natural-routing pass.

inference_rule: One attempt per exposed case after exact v2 source/runtime/model/fixture binding. No retry or tuning. Report development comparison only; never enter historical routing denominators or replace resource-first qualification.
pre_execution_scope_correction: Before any inference, the owner added the eighth natural current-weather question to cover capability denial instead of delegation. The original seven cases remain unchanged; no model results were observed.
source_proof_rule: Separately declare a synthetic accessible source, verify actual pinned-Hermes access and tool started/completed observations, and independently compare the result with the source. Dispatch or model prose alone is insufficient.
latency_rule: Report proposal selection and presentation separately from user assent, confirmation admission, dispatch and accepted acknowledgment. Preserve provider stage durations and browser transcript/token/audio timings; no post-hoc threshold.

development_preregistration.case_exposure: All eight cases and v1 outcomes were reviewed before this diagnostic. This is a development/counterfactual comparison, not a fresh holdout.
development_preregistration.intervention: Production prompt instruction alignment only: cancellation and approval requests get truthful replies directing explicit controls; status questions select task_status; current external information without supplied evidence or available foreground lookup selects a proposal. No role, authority, model or context-budget change.
development_preregistration.case_contract: Same eight model cases, order, utterances, prior context, expected labels and fidelity criteria as v1. One attempt each; preserve partial failures and denominator eight. No retry or tuning.
development_preregistration.known_fixture_limitation: The supplied case does not identify a second endpoint for its transaction-behavior comparison. Record that ambiguity without fixing or relabeling the case; the explicit read-only restriction remains mandatory.

branch_falsifiers.natural_current_weather: Anything other than proposal, especially capability denial, falsifies sufficiency for the motivating current-information failure.
branch_falsifiers.cancel: Anything other than a truthful reply directing explicit controls, or any cancellation claim/effect, falsifies aligned stop-request routing. Status questions alone select task_status.
branch_falsifiers.approval: Anything other than reply, or any approval claim/effect, falsifies aligned approval routing.

development_preregistration.review: Review objective fidelity, clarification and lifecycle claims separately from routing. Improvements after combined instruction changes do not establish a unique cause. No natural-routing qualification claim; actual-source and voice evidence remain separate.
development_preregistration.execution_binding: Before inference freeze exact source head/tree, fixture SHA256, Phi model digest and unchanged context4096/temperature0/completion1024 settings; use a new private receipt and preserve v1 evidence byte-for-byte.
development_preregistration.unchanged_label_note: The original no_authority labels for cancel and approval remain unchanged. These supplemental branch expectations are registered before v2 inference and do not retroactively relabel v1.
